info.name: HQT Backend - Auth, People, Courses & Platform
info.description:
Requests for testing the Hafiz Quran Tutor backend's Auth & Identity (Phase 2), People (Phase 3), Courses (Phase 4), and Platform (media/audit/settings) domains. Import this file into Postman, then run requests top to bottom inside each folder - tokens are saved automatically between requests via collection variables.

Make sure the backend is running locally first: `npm run start:dev` in hqt_backend/, and that you've run `npx prisma db seed` at least once (creates the super admin account and the six initial courses used by the People/Courses folders).

request.description: Should always return 200 if the server process is up at all.
Returns 200 only if the server can actually reach PostgreSQL.

request.description: Creates a new PARENT account. Self-registration only allows STUDENT or PARENT - see the negative test below.

exec: pm.test('New refresh token differs from old', () => pm.expect(body.refreshToken).to.not.eql(oldRefresh));

request.description: Trades the current refresh token for a brand new access+refresh pair. The old refresh token is revoked (rotation) - run this request twice in a row and the second call will 401.
Revokes the current session. After this, both the access token's underlying session and the refresh token are dead.

item.name: Platform
item.description: Media (uploads/attachments), the SUPER_ADMIN-only audit log, and system settings (with an ADMIN-vs-SUPER_ADMIN RBAC contrast on the settings PUT route). Run 'People > 0. Admin Login' first, then this folder's own '0. Create Plain Admin' and '1. Plain Admin Login' requests before anything that uses {{plainAdminToken}}. The media-attach request also needs {{courseId}}, so run 'Courses > Admin - Create Course (Draft)' at least once this session.

request.description: {{adminToken}} is the SUPER_ADMIN token from 'People > 0. Admin Login' - only a SUPER_ADMIN may provision another ADMIN account. Used below to demonstrate that a plain ADMIN has narrower access than SUPER_ADMIN on Platform routes.
Run '0. Create Plain Admin' first so plainAdminEmail is set.

multipart/form-data, not JSON - click into the 'file' field and select a local file before sending (jpeg/png/webp/pdf only, max 10MB). 'visibility' is optional; PUBLIC files can be read by anyone, PRIVATE ones only by the uploader or an ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN.
Returns file metadata (name, mime type, size, visibility) - not the file bytes themselves. Run 'Media - Upload File' first.
Streams the actual file bytes with the original Content-Type and an inline Content-Disposition.

Links an already-uploaded file to a course (e.g. a course thumbnail). entityType must be one of STUDENT_PROFILE/TEACHER_PROFILE/COURSE/TESTIMONIAL. Needs {{courseId}} - run 'Courses > Admin - Create Course (Draft)' first.
SUPER_ADMIN-only, entire controller. Every successful mutation on a role-guarded route (e.g. the requests above) shows up here as an append-only entry.
Unlike /settings below, the audit log has no ADMIN carve-out at all - a plain ADMIN token is rejected here even though it can read (but not write) /settings.
Create-or-update (upsert) by key. SUPER_ADMIN-only - see the RBAC contrast further down: a plain ADMIN can GET settings but not PUT them.
Run 'Settings - Upsert Setting (Super Admin)' first.
The controller's default @Roles(ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN) covers both GET routes - a plain ADMIN can read settings.
The PUT handler re-declares @Roles(SUPER_ADMIN), tighter than the controller's default ADMIN+SUPER_ADMIN read access - a plain ADMIN token that can GET settings gets 403 here.

item.name: Enrollment

Communication
item.description: Phase 8 - direct/group messaging, role-targeted announcements, and the in-app notification feed. Run 'People', 'Enrollment' and 'Auth - Happy Path' first this session so adminToken/teacherToken/studentToken/parentToken are all set.

item.name: Setup - Teacher Gets Own User Id

request.description: Messaging works on raw user ids, not profile ids. Captures teacherUserId from the JWT's underlying user record.

item.name: Setup - Student Gets Own User Id

request.description: Only 2 participants and no explicit type - defaults to a DIRECT conversation between the teacher and student.
Sending a message notifies every other participant (NEW_MESSAGE) - the student's notifications list below picks this up.

item.name: Parent - Cannot Read Conversation They Are Not In (expect 403)

request.description: The parent account is not a participant in this conversation.

item.name: Teacher - Send Message To Nonexistent Conversation (expect 404)
Admin - Create Draft Announcement Targeted At Students

request.description: New announcements start as DRAFT and are not fanned out or shown in feeds until published.

item.name: Student - Draft Announcement Not Yet In Feed

request.description: Announcements are ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only.

CreateAnnouncementDto.targets is validated with @ValidateNested({ each: true }) + @Type(() => AnnouncementTargetDto), so a bad nested target is correctly rejected with 400 instead of crashing or being silently ignored.
Publishing fans out an ANNOUNCEMENT notification to every currently matching user (here: everyone with the STUDENT role).

item.name: Student - Sees Published Announcement In Feed

request.description: Should include both the NEW_MESSAGE notification from the earlier message and the ANNOUNCEMENT notification from the publish above.

item.name: Teacher - Cannot Mark Student's Notification Read (expect 404)

request.description: markRead scopes the lookup by { id, userId } - a notification id that exists but belongs to someone else looks not-found, not forbidden.
